title: Life

content:
2011 – 2018 # Statistician and data scientist Post CH AG # During my first year at the Post Office, I worked in market research. I conducted customer satisfaction surveys and focused in particular on analyzing customer journeys.
I then moved to the Finance department, where I held a management position. In addition to my primary responsibility of analyzing financial and inventory flows, I worked with the business unit to develop ideas for projects, identify appropriate methods and processes, and then implement them in production in collaboration with IT. I also won an internal innovation award for this work. The projects spanned a wide range of departments, including logistics, finance, and controlling. One example was forecasting the arrival times of package shipments.
title: Postal Service

content:
2018 – 2022 # Data Officer of Federal Office for Customs and Border Security (FOCBS) # As the first and sole Data Officer, I built and established the BAZG’s data governance organization. It is based on the data policy I developed. Serving as an interface between IT and management, the data governance organization is a central component of the FOCBS’s digital transformation process. Specifically, this task involved implementing a software-based system for organizing data, including the assignment of domains, ownership, and responsibilities; above all, however, it involved defining processes.
As part of the large-scale DaziT project, my role was to work with my team to develop and maintain a comprehensive data model. My team consisted primarily of business analysts. I was also responsible for ensuring data quality at both the procedural and technical levels. In addition, I represented the FOCBS in the development of e-government solutions on federal level.
title: FOCBS

content:
2001 – 2005 # Freelancer # After graduating, I started out working as a freelancer. I did this almost exclusively for GIABmbH in Erfurt, Germany. My work primarily involved evaluating economic surveys and analyzing other economic data.
I took a break from this job for a little over six months to complete an internship at FER Mexicana, a supplier in the automotive industry based in Puebla, Mexico. My responsibilities were as varied as is typical in the management of a small company.
title: Freelancer
